policy: Every valid track must receive at least a canonical main genre.
Use a parent fallback plus review flags when a subtype is not defensible.
Artist-profile evidence is allowed; broad/conflicting labels require documented judgment.
Propose precise new taxonomy nodes, but merge synonyms as aliases.

proposed_subgenres.name: Raw Trance
proposed_subgenres.bpm_justification: The affected exact recording is 144 BPM, within the 132–145 BPM fast-tech master range.
proposed_subgenres.rationale: A recognized contemporary trance lane emphasizing raw percussion, hypnotic repetition and techno-adjacent drive; it is more specific than the Trance parent and is not a synonym of Neo Trance or Hard Trance.
